async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the 'Change branches' link to modify the target branch
    change_branches_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Change branches')
    await change_branches_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 2: On the branch selection page, set target branch to 'master'
    # Assuming there is a button for target branch selection
    target_branch_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Select target branch')
    if await target_branch_button.count() > 0:
        await target_branch_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
        # Select 'master' from the dropdown
        master_option = page.get_by_role('listitem').filter(has=page.get_by_text('master', exact=True))
        if await master_option.count() == 0:
            master_option = page.get_by_role('link', name='master', exact=True)
        await master_option.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    else:
        # Fallback: if target branch is a textbox
        target_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Target branch')
        if await target_field.count() > 0:
            await target_field.fill('master')
    
    # Step 3: Click 'Compare branches and continue' to return to the merge request form
    compare_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Compare branches and continue')
    await compare_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Step 4: Assign Justin Armstrong as reviewer
    # Use the 'Unassigned' button, but note there are two buttons with this name (assignee and reviewer)
    # From the previous error, the second one is for reviewer, so use .nth(1) to select the correct one
    unassigned_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Unassigned').nth(1)
    await unassigned_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    # Fill in the search box and select Justin Armstrong
    reviewer_search = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Search GitLab')
    if await reviewer_search.count() > 0:
        await reviewer_search.fill('Justin Armstrong')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)  # Wait for search results
    # Select Justin Armstrong from the dropdown
    justin_option = page.get_by_role('menuitem', name='Justin Armstrong project a11yproject.com')
    if await justin_option.count() == 0:
        justin_option = page.get_by_role('menuitem', name='Justin Armstrong all GitLab')
    await justin_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Step 5: Fill in the title (required)
    title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title (required)')
    await title_field.fill('Merge redesign into master')
    
    # Step 6: Uncheck the draft checkbox (it is checked according to the tree)
    draft_checkbox = page.get_by_role('checkbox', name='Mark as draft Drafts cannot be merged until marked ready.')
    if await draft_checkbox.is_checked():
        await draft_checkbox.click()
    
    # Step 7: Fill in a description
    description_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_field.fill('Merging the redesign branch into master as per task.')
    
    # Step 8: Submit the merge request
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit merge request')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Return a success message as the result
    return 'Merge request submitted successfully for a11yproject.com redesign branch to master, with Justin Armstrong assigned as reviewer.'
